title: Bengio and 400 Researchers Demand AI and Security Alliance
summary:
A coalition of academics has issued a public appeal for the artificial intelligence and cybersecurity sectors to integrate their efforts to shield national infrastructure. Yoshua Bengio and more than 400 fellow researchers signed an open letter demanding that these communities coordinate on alignment and containment measures to protect digital systems.

The group provided a series of recommendations to bridge the gap between academic AI safety specialists and professional security experts. One signatory noted that treating the two disciplines as a zero sum tradeoff is a mistake, as both are essential to maintaining the safety of modern technological assets.
